adjudication.rationale: In handleNewBooking.ts, `teamMemberPromises = users.slice(1).map(...)` and the comment “Organizer ... is not listed as a team member” implicitly assumes `users[0]` is the organizer. But `loadUsers()` can return users from `prisma.user.findMany({ where: { username: { in: dynamicUserList }}})` without any ordering, so the “first user” is not guaranteed to be the organizer; the first user’s `destinationCalendar` would be skipped from `teamDestinationCalendars` because only `users.slice(1)` are considered. Also, `evt.destinationCalendar` is set to `null` when neither `eventType.destinationCalendar` nor `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` exists, and later `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)` is guarded by optional chaining, so team destination calendars are dropped entirely in that case instead of initializing the array.
